app.description: Bookkeeping and accounting system for businesses in Indonesia.

landing.heroHeading: Tidy books for one company — or many
landing.heroBody: Record transactions, close the period, and produce financial statements and VAT figures without being an accountant. Every company keeps its own ledger, all under one account.
landing.heroNote: Invited by a colleague? Use the invitation link in your email.
landing.featureCompaniesBody: Every company writes to its own database, so one company's entries never bleed into another's. Switching takes one menu.
landing.featureRolesBody: Permissions are set per role, and every significant action leaves a trail: who, when, and what changed.
landing.featureTaxBody: Tax follows the applicable rules, and the data can be prepared for e-Faktur — not bolted on afterwards outside the system.
landing.featureLanguageBody: Indonesian, English, and Chinese. Everyone reads the same screen in their own language.
landing.snippetAuditRow: Every action is logged: who · when · what
landing.modulesBody: Sales, purchasing, stock, cash and bank, fixed assets, tax — all posted to one ledger per company, so reports never have to be assembled from several applications. The list below is read straight from the modules the application actually ships, so it cannot name something that does not exist.
landing.modulesNote: Modules are enabled per company, not per account: two companies under one account may run different modules.
landing.pricingBody: Pick the plan for the number of companies and users you need today; you can upgrade yourself at any time as the business grows. The figures come straight from the live catalogue — not an image someone has to remember to update.
landing.pricingTrialNote: New accounts start with a {days}-day trial.
landing.pricingContactSupport: Data migration, team training, direct support
landing.pricingContactMissing: No contact address is configured on this installation.
landing.pricingNegotiateNote: Need more than {companies} companies or {users} users? Quota, data migration, SLA, and contract period are negotiated.
landing.faqTrialQ: How long is the trial, and when does it start?
landing.faqTrialA: {days} days, counted from the moment you click the verification link in your email — not from when you submit the registration form.
landing.faqAfterTrialQ: What happens if I stop paying?
landing.faqAfterTrialA: The account moves to past due, then to suspended. Suspended means READ-ONLY — not locked and not deleted: your books remain, stay openable, and stay downloadable. The duty to retain accounting records does not end because an invoice is unpaid.
landing.faqQuotaQ: What if I need more companies or users?
landing.faqQuotaA: Change plan yourself from the account page. The difference is prorated over the remainder of the current period, and your next billing date does not move. Downgrades are refused while your usage still exceeds the new quota.
landing.faqTaxA: No. {rate}% VAT is added on top of the plan price and appears as its own line on the invoice.
landing.faqIsolationQ: If I run several companies, can their data mix?
landing.faqIsolationA: No. Each company writes to its own database — not one shared table filtered by a column. Modules are enabled per company too.
landing.faqExportQ: If I leave, can I take my data?
landing.faqExportA: Yes. The full books of every one of your companies can be downloaded as a ZIP of CSV files — readable without this application. Export keeps working even while an account is suspended; that is precisely when it matters.

landing.trustBody: Books are records you must be able to stand behind for years — to owners, auditors, and the tax office. The four mechanisms below already run in the application, and their documentation is open to check before you create an account.
landing.trustIsolationBody: Not one shared table filtered by a column: every company writes to its own database, so entries have no path to bleed into one another.
landing.trustRolesBody: The built-in permission matrix can be overridden per role from the settings page — without code changes, and without giving everyone full access.
landing.trustAuditTitle: An audit trail that cannot be bypassed
landing.trustAuditBody: Every significant action records who, when, and what changed. The record is written on the same path as the change, not bolted on afterwards.
landing.trustExportTitle: Your data can leave with you
landing.trustExportBody: Every company’s full books can be downloaded as a ZIP of CSV files — and the export keeps working while an account is suspended.
landing.faqMoreText: Other questions are usually already answered in the documentation.
landing.ctaTrialNote: {days}-day trial. Nothing to install on your computer.
landing.pricingAllNote: Every plan includes {modules} modules, {languages} interface languages, and the currencies {currencies}. Only the number of companies and users is metered per plan.
landing.faqImportQ: I already have data in another application. Can I bring it over?
landing.faqImportA: Yes, from Excel files (.xlsx) using downloadable templates: chart of accounts (columns follow the Accurate convention), customers, suppliers, items, opening receivables and payables, and fixed assets. Columns are matched by header, faulty rows are reported line by line, and existing records are never overwritten. Opening account balances are entered in the setup wizard; historical transactions are not imported — the books here start from opening balances.
landing.faqAccountantQ: Can an external accountant or audit firm work in my books?
landing.faqAccountantA: Yes. Invite them by email from the Users page, choose their role per company, and they set their own password — passwords are never sent in messages. Permissions are set per role (built-in roles can be tuned, and you can create your own), every action they take lands in the audit trail, and access can be revoked at any time. Invitations count towards your plan's user quota.
landing.faqSupportQ: Where do I turn when something goes wrong?
landing.faqSupportA: The product documentation is public and can be read before you sign up. For anything else, write to {email} — we reply to the address you write from.
landing.faqSupportADocsOnly: The product documentation is public and can be read before you sign up — start from the Documentation link in the page footer.
landing.faqDataQ: Where is my data stored, and what rights do I have over it?
landing.faqDataA: Each company's ledger lives in its own database, separate from other companies and from user account data. You can export the full books at any time, and deletion happens only at the account owner's request — with a 30-day grace period that can be cancelled; nothing is deleted automatically. Our privacy policy, written with reference to Indonesia's PDP Law, is open on the Privacy policy page.
landing.faqFitQ: What kind of business is it for?
landing.faqFitA: Businesses in Indonesia that need proper books without an accounting department of their own — one company or several. The setup wizard offers presets for {categories}; beyond that you choose your own set from the {modules} available modules. Modules are switched on per company and can be changed at any time without touching what is already recorded.
landing.audienceBody: Modules are switched on per company, so each segment below uses a different part of the same engine. Module names are read from the same registry as the list above.
landing.audienceTradingBody: Forward contracts, delivery orders, a B/L and COO archive, warehoused stock, and invoices in USD, CNY, or IDR that can be prepared for e-Faktur — the trading layer general bookkeeping rarely has.
landing.audienceHoldingBody: One account for every company, each company in its own database, roles per person per company, and an approval queue so large entries do not just slip through.
landing.audienceLanguageBody: The interface in Indonesian, English, and Chinese — chosen per person, not per company. A team in Jakarta and a partner in China read the same screen.
landing.audienceServicesBody: No stock and no trading layer: core accounting, cash and bank with statement reconciliation, fixed assets and their depreciation. Other modules can be switched on later.
landing.integrationsHeading: Data in and out, without retyping
landing.integrationsBody: Nothing is locked inside: every item below is a path that actually exists in the application, and those with documentation link to it.
landing.integrationEfakturBody: Output and export invoices become a DJP/Coretax-oriented CSV, with any missing NPWP or PEB number flagged.
landing.integrationBankBody: Import statement lines from CSV and match them against the cash and bank book — the difference is computed, not guessed.
landing.integrationImportBody: Chart of accounts, customers, suppliers, items, open receivables/payables, and fixed assets from Excel templates whose columns are recognised by header.
landing.integrationApiBody: Accounts, customers, suppliers, items, and invoices over an API with per-company tokens carrying the same permissions as users, plus an OpenAPI specification.
landing.integrationExportBody: Every company’s full books download as a ZIP of CSV files, and every report as Excel or PDF.
landing.integrationCurrencyBody: Any document can be in USD, CNY, or IDR; the rate and rupiah base value are stored with every transaction.

penyiapan.label: Setup & Opening Balances
penyiapan.description: The zero point of your books — already done. Open it to review.

monthlyRoutine.title: {month} routine
monthlyRoutine.subtitle: {month} has ended but its books are not locked yet. These three tidy it up before closing.

pengeluaran.label: Record last month's expenses
pengeluaran.description: Every payment out — rent, wages, utilities, purchases. What is not recorded never reaches the reports.

cocokkan_bank.label: Reconcile the bank statement
cocokkan_bank.description: Match your own records against the bank's. A difference is usually a transaction you missed.

tutup_bulan.label: Review the reports, then close the books
tutup_bulan.description: Read last month's Profit & Loss and Balance Sheet. If they look right, lock the month so the figures can no longer change.

beranda.title: Getting to know the Home page

s1.title: Welcome
s1.body: This short tour shows three things: how to record everyday work, how to read the summary figures, and where to look up what a term means. You can skip it at any time and replay it from the Help menu.

s2.title: Quick Actions
s2.body: The jobs you do most often live here — record a sale, receive money, and so on. Only what you are allowed to do and what this company actually uses is shown, so the list differs between users. One click straight to the form.

s3.title: Plain-language summary
s3.body: This month's key figures without accounting jargon. Every card links to its source report, so each number can always be checked.

s4.title: A menu per kind of work
s4.body: The left-hand menu is grouped by job — sales, purchasing, cash & bank, reports, and so on. Groups for features this company does not use are simply not shown, so your menu may be shorter than someone else's.

s5.title: Help & Glossary
s5.body: Not sure what a term means? Open the Help menu for the Glossary, or replay this page's tour at any time.

s1.title: Why this page exists
s1.body: A large-value transaction does not go straight into the books — it waits for a decision here first. The document itself is safely saved; only its journal entry is held back.

s2.title: Waiting for Your Decision
s2.body: The queue you have to decide on. Open the document through the link, then Approve (its journal is issued immediately) or Reject with a reason so the requester knows what to fix.

s3.title: My Submissions
s3.body: News about the documents you submitted: still waiting, approved, or rejected with the reason. A rejected document can be corrected and resubmitted from here.

s4.title: Decision History
s4.body: Every decision your role has ever made is recorded here — and it can be sorted, so questions like “the largest decision this month” are easy to answer.

s1.title: Creating an invoice
s1.body: This page creates a sales invoice for a customer. Fill in the invoice's identity, then its list of goods. If you would rather be guided step by step, use “Record a Sale” in the Sales menu.

s2.title: Invoice identity
s2.body: The invoice number, date, payment deadline, customer, and currency. For a foreign currency the rate is required, so the value is recorded in rupiah.

s3.title: The goods being sold
s3.body: Add the item, the quantity, and the unit price. The total is computed automatically, including sales tax where it applies.

s4.title: Save
s4.body: Once saved, the invoice appears in the list straight away and its outstanding balance moves into "Unpaid by Customers" until it is settled.

s1.title: Report Centre
s1.body: Every report lives on this one page, grouped by category. Pick a report, set its period, then export it to PDF or Excel.

s2.title: Start with the ones used most
s2.body: "Profit or Loss" answers whether the month was profitable; "Wealth & Debt Position" shows the situation on one date; "Money In & Out" traces the cash that actually moved.

s3.title: What each term means
s3.body: Report names use everyday language; the formal term can be opened through the "?" icon or in the Glossary from the Help menu.

unlock.title: Open the company books
unlock.description: Enter your password to open the books of {company}.
unlock.failed: Wrong password, or you are not a member of this company.
unlock.tooMany: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
unlock.hint: Asked once per working day for each company. It is the same password you sign in with.

demoCompany.title: This is a sample company.
demoCompany.body: It holds made-up data so you can see what filled-in reports look like. The figures are not real bookkeeping and cannot be edited. Create a new company to start keeping your own books.

masterImport.title: Import Starting Data
masterImport.description: Move your customer, supplier, and item lists from Excel — without retyping them.
masterImport.templateHint: The template carries the column headers, one example row, and an instructions sheet. Column order is free — columns are recognised by their heading.
masterImport.uploadHint: An .xlsx file, 5 MB max. If ANY row is wrong, nothing is saved — fix it and upload again.
masterImport.doneBody: {created} new rows added, {skipped} skipped because the name already exists, out of {total} rows.
masterImport.truncated: The file exceeded the 10,000-row limit; the rest was not read.

apiTokens.title: API Tokens
apiTokens.description: Credentials for external systems to read this company's books through /api/v1.
apiTokens.roleHint: The token reads as the role you pick — exactly the permissions a user with that role has, including modules that are switched off.
apiTokens.freshWarning: Copy it now. This token will NOT be shown again — only its fingerprint is stored.
apiTokens.revokeBody: Token “{name}” stops working immediately. Integrations using it will fail on their next request. Its record is kept.
apiTokens.emptyBody: Issue one to give an external system read access to this company's books.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.emptyDescription: Anything important — such as an unfinished setup — will show up here.

accurate.title: Accurate integration
accurate.description: Match Accurate's General Ledger Detail against the books here — without changing a single figure.
accurate.readOnlyNotice: This page only reads. No account is created and no journal is posted — a general ledger detail report carries only one side of each transaction, so it cannot become a journal.
accurate.prepStep1: In Accurate, open Reports → General Ledger → General Ledger Detail.
accurate.prepStep2: Pick the period and accounts you want to match, then export to Excel.
accurate.prepStep3: Upload the file as it is — don't edit it first. Repeated page headers and cells split across page breaks are cleaned up automatically.
accurate.sourceApiSoon: Accurate Open API — not available yet
accurate.filePlaceholder: Choose a General Ledger Detail file (.xlsx)
accurate.repairJoined: Row {row}: fragment "{text}" was joined back onto row {into} — the cell was split by a page break.
accurate.repairStray: Row {row}: fragment "{text}" could not be attributed to a row, so it was left as it is.
accurate.matchBreakdown: {exact} full match · {amountDate} date & amount · {referenceOnly} reference matches but the date differs
accurate.truncated: The lists below are capped at 100 rows; the summary figures are still counted in full.
accurate.draftDescription: Closing balances from Accurate, already mapped to a debit or credit side using the chart of accounts here. Download it, check it, then enter it through the Opening Balance wizard — this file is never uploaded back.
accurate.draftUnknown: These accounts do not exist in the chart of accounts yet: {codes}. Create them under Accounts first so their side can be determined.

tenantSlug.heading: Account address
tenantSlug.hint: This address appears in every link to your books. You may change it — the old address keeps redirecting here forever, and is never given to another account.
tenantSlug.warning: Old links STILL WORK, but people who saved them will see the address change. Changeable once every 30 days.
tenantSlug.confirmBody: Type the new address once more to confirm: {slug}
tenantSlug.forbidden: That address is reserved by the system. Pick another.
tenantSlug.same: That is already the current address.
tenantSlug.taken: That address is taken — including if another account used it in the past.
tenantSlug.tooSoon: The address was just changed. It can be changed again 30 days later.
